site.name: Web AI Models
site.tagline: A curated catalog of browser-side AI models
site.description: Discover, compare and learn about AI models that run entirely in the browser. No servers. No tracking. Just open standards.

home.title: Browser-side AI models
home.subtitle: An open catalog of AI models you can run in the browser — for display and comparison only.
home.aboutLead: The era of running AI in the browser has quietly arrived. Thanks to WebGPU, WebAssembly, and projects like Transformers.js, WebLLM, MediaPipe, ONNX Runtime Web, TensorFlow.js and Whisper.cpp, models that used to require a GPU cluster now run inside a webpage — no backend, no API key, no telemetry.
home.aboutBody: Web AI Models is a curated, display-only catalog of those models. It is built for engineers, researchers and product teams who want to understand what's actually possible on the client today: which models exist, what they cost in MB, which framework they target, what license they ship under, and where to find the original demo or documentation. Nothing on this site runs inference — every entry links out to the upstream project so you can try it yourself.
home.whatLead: Nine categories and twenty-five subcategories covering the modern browser-AI stack.

whatItems.title: Text & LLM
whatItems.body: Classical NLP (classification, translation, summarization) and on-device large language models for chat, structured output and code.

whatItems.title: Search & RAG
whatItems.body: Embedding, cross-encoder reranking and ANN indexes that power semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation entirely in JavaScript.

whatItems.title: Vision
whatItems.body: Object detection, segmentation, OCR and monocular depth from YOLO, MediaPipe, SAM, Tesseract, MiDaS and more.

whatItems.title: Generative Vision
whatItems.body: Stable Diffusion Turbo, SDXL, FLUX, LaMa inpainting and other diffusion-style models that generate or edit pixels on WebGPU.

whatItems.title: Audio
whatItems.body: Whisper (Xenova/whisper-small & whisper-base) for speech recognition, Kokoro 82M / Piper / Silero for synthesis, RNNoise / DeepFilterNet for denoising and HT Demucs (4 / 6 stems) for source separation.

whatItems.title: Multimodal
whatItems.body: Vision-language models like Moondream, LLaVA, PaliGemma, plus CLIP, SigLIP and document understanding transformers.

whatItems.title: Real-time
whatItems.body: MediaPipe and TensorFlow.js pipelines for face, pose, hand and 3D-object tracking — the perceptual layer for any in-browser AR or analytics product.

whatItems.title: Video
whatItems.body: VideoCLIP, X-CLIP, VideoMAE and MediaPipe Video Classifier for action recognition and video retrieval.
